It makes intuitive sense for #ux to “get ahead” of developers. What you find, in practice, is that if you relax pressure on devs to “stay busy”, and you tackle design together ... you 1) preserve sanity, and 2) “deliver” faster. Counterintuitive but true.

#design #agile

OH: “We’ll just do away with the hierarchy and managers. It’ll be so much easier.”

FYI: Flat/decentralized /outcome focused orgs require *more* collaboration, more safety, more empathy, and more crucial conversations. It doesn’t get easier. You just do better work
